name: AI 3D Studio
release_notes: Fix: TTS no longer reads [Sound effect: ...] markers aloud. Fix: TTS no longer reads AI confidence footers aloud. Fix: all SFX sound effects in a response now play correctly (previously only the first effect was heard). Fix: SFX ambient/looping sounds now continue across the full response without stopping and restarting. Fix: TTS speaks after the full response completes for clear, reliable playback.
